form.label: Windows Event Log Relay - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Windows Event XML relay overview. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=oswinsec sourcetype IN ("windows:eventlog:process","windows:eventlog:powershell") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:defender" host=$host_tok$ event_id=1116 | stats count
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security" host=$host_tok$ event_id IN (4625,4771) | stats count
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security" host=$host_tok$ event_id IN (1102,4663,4697,4698,4719,4720,4726,4732,4738) | stats count
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ marker="SC4S_WINDOWS_EVENTLOG_TEST_*" | stats dc(marker) as markers

panel.title: Events over time by Windows family

search.query: index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval windows_family=case(sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security","security",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:process","process",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:powershell","powershell",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:defender","defender",true(),sourcetype) | timechart count by windows_family

index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval windows_family=case(sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security","security",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:process","process",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:powershell","powershell",sourcetype="windows:eventlog:defender","defender",true(),sourcetype) | stats count by windows_family | sort -count
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by event_id provider | sort -count | head 20
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | eval windows_user=coalesce(user, src_user) | stats count by windows_user | sort -count | head 20
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ src_ip=* | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 20

index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host event_id provider user user_domain src_user src_user_domain src_ip src_port logon_type workstation package_name failure_reason status sub_status object_name object_type access_mask audit_policy_changes service_name service_file_name dest signature signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Object, account/group, audit log, policy, service, and scheduled-task triage

search.query: index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:security" host=$host_tok$ event_id IN (1102,4663,4697,4698,4719,4726,4732,4738) | table _time host event_id provider src_user src_user_domain object_name object_type access_mask access_list object_process policy_category policy_subcategory audit_policy_changes service_name service_file_name service_type service_start_type service_account target_sid member_name member_sid subject_logon_id display_name user_principal_name sam_account_name user_account_control task_name task_content dest signature signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=oswinsec sourcetype IN ("windows:eventlog:process","windows:eventlog:powershell") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype event_id user src_user dest process process_command_line parent_process script_block_text signature marker | sort -_time | head 100
index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:defender" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host event_id provider severity threat_name file_path dest signature signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

panel.title: Recent raw Windows Event XML records

search.query: index=oswinsec sourcetype="windows:eventlog:*" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype event_id provider user user_domain src_user src_user_domain src_ip src_port logon_type workstation package_name failure_reason status sub_status object_name object_type access_mask access_list object_process audit_policy_changes policy_category policy_subcategory service_name service_file_name service_start_type service_account target_sid member_name member_sid subject_logon_id display_name user_principal_name sam_account_name user_account_control task_name task_content dest process process_command_line parent_process script_block_text threat_name file_path severity signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
